tools.name: normalize-pn
tools.description: Normalize an IT hardware part number into its standard form. Handles HPE (B21/001/spare), Dell (400-XXXX, DP/N), and IBM/Lenovo (FRU) formats. Critical for deduplication and accurate lookups.

tools.name: validate-pn
tools.description: Validate a part number and check whether it exists in the PartsTable catalog (26,182,530 distinct part numbers, measured 2026-10-28), from government, OEM, and commercial authority sources. Returns structural validity and catalog existence.

tools.name: get-part
tools.description: Get the part record: identity, manufacturer, description, category, lifecycle, and government classification (NSN/FSC) when present. Sourced from the PartsTable read model.

tools.name: get-substitutes
tools.description: Find substitute / equivalent / cross-referenced part numbers in the PartsTable cross-reference graph (2,001,002 cross-references, measured 2026-10-18).

tools.name: search-parts
tools.description: Look up a batch of part numbers (max 25) against the PartsTable catalog. Returns per-part identity summary and whether each exists.
